abilities.effect: The vault makes a poison dart spray Strike at a random creature within 30 feet. The trap then rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Exposed  Vault
Electrify
abilities.text: The metal vault crackles with electricity. In air, this would damage only creatures touching it; in water, the trap deals 2d8 electricity damage to all creatures in a 10-foot emanation (DC 25 basic Fortitude save).

abilities.name: Launch Darts
abilities.text: The vault fires a stream of poisoned darts. The trap attacks all creatures in a 30-foot line with its poison dart spray Strike; roll 1d8 to determine the line's direction. These Strikes don't have a multiple attack penalty.

abilities.name: Spin
abilities.text: The vault spins quickly for 1 round. While it Spins, checks to disable the trap have a –2 circumstance penalty, and it Launches Darts at all creatures within 30 feet of it, rather than in a line.

traits.name: Range
traits.text: These attacks will either list a finite range or a range increment, which follows the normal rules for range increments.

hazard.description: A 5-foot-square metal vault covered with knobs lies concealed within a stone block. A lever on the stone block slides the vault into view. When the vault is exposed—whether it's slid out or whether the stone is smashed open—the trap activates.
hazard.disable: DC 24 Thievery (trained) to find and press hidden knobs in a specific order (three successes are required to disable the trap, which also opens it); DC 24 Crafting (expert) to sabotage the vault's mechanisms, reducing its actions by 1 (when the trap's actions are reduced to 0, it is disabled)
hazard.name: Keystone Trap
hazard.routine: (3 actions) The keystone uses its 3 actions to Electrify, Spin, and then Launch Darts. When the trap loses an action, roll randomly to determine which action it loses.

traits.name: Unique
traits.text: A rules element with this trait is one-of-a-kind. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to creatures with this trait is increased by 10.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard or item with this trait is constructed to hinder interlopers.
